title: Synthetic vendor onboarding fixture
description: Constructed graph-surface fixture: approve or decline a vendor from the screening decision's outcome, which an upstream graph node feeds as a fact and as evidence availability. Synthetic content for runtime testing; it authorizes nothing.

decision.intent: Decide whether the vendor proceeds to onboarding once the screening decision is known.
decision.question: Should this vendor be onboarded, given the screening decision's outcome?

evidenceRequirements.description: The upstream screening decision's produced outcome.

outcomes.label: Approve
outcomes.description: The screening decision cleared the vendor.

outcomes.label: Decline
outcomes.description: The screening decision matched the vendor.

rules.description: Approve the vendor when the screening decision produced the clear outcome.
rules.rationale: A screening that resolved nothing is not a clearance, and this pack never infers one.

rules.description: Decline the vendor when the screening decision produced the hit outcome.
rules.rationale: The same missing status blocks a decline for the same reason it blocks an approval.

escalation.message: Escalate a vendor whose screening decision cannot be established.
